Record a verified study identity

Source: R/study_update_identity.R
study_update_identity.Rd

Writes a Study Tracker identity into an existing _study.yml and marks it verified: identity_source: tracker and identity_verified: true. Every other key, including the data contract (built, cohort, additional_datasets, population, citation), keeps its value.

Usage

study_update_identity(identity, start = getwd())

Arguments

identity

A named list from the Study Tracker record. It must hold study_tracker_id, equal to the manifest's, and study; it may hold umbrella, owner, irb_number, cvir_no and study_creation_date.

start

A directory inside the study; the study is found as study_config finds it.

Value

The names of the keys whose values changed, invisibly.

Details

This is the write step of verifying a manual identity. It does not read Study Tracker or compare the record with the typed identity; the caller does both, and passes the record only when they match. A field the record leaves NULL keeps its current value.

The file is rewritten whole and atomically, as register_data rewrites it, so comments in _study.yml are not kept.

See also

study_setup, study_status.

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "update-identity-example")
study_setup(root, "Typed title", 42L, identity_source = "manual",
            renv = FALSE)
#> Study: /tmp/Rtmpb03RvU/update-identity-example
#> 
#> [~] _study.yml — study: Typed title; identity entered by hand, confirm it with study-setup --verify
#> [ ] renv.lock — no renv.lock; run renv::init() in the study project
#> [ ] manifest.yaml — no manifest.yaml; register_data() creates it
#> [ ] dataset — no default dataset registered; run register_data()
#> [ ] provenance — no .qmd/.Rmd sources found; 0 sidecars
#> 
#> 0 .R  |  0 .qmd/.Rmd  |  0 .sas  |  0 provenance sidecars
study_update_identity(
  list(study_tracker_id = 42L, study = "Typed title", owner = "Analyst"),
  start = root
)
study_config(root, require_data = FALSE)$identity_verified
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(root, recursive = TRUE)
